name: anythingllm-mcp
description: Async chat + workspace management for AnythingLLM over its REST API. The async pattern (ask_workspace -> get_answer) avoids the ~60s MCP tool-call timeout on slow local models.

base_url.title: AnythingLLM Base URL
base_url.description: Base URL of your AnythingLLM instance, e.g. http://10.47.40.43:3001

api_key.title: AnythingLLM API Key
api_key.description: Developer API key from AnythingLLM (Settings -> Tools -> Developer API)

tools.name: ask_workspace
tools.description: Start an async workspace chat query; returns a job_id instantly.

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Fetch an ask_workspace job by job_id (pending|done|error).

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Get one workspace's settings and documents.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List documents known to the system.

tools.name: update_embeddings
tools.description: Add/remove documents in a workspace's embeddings.
